name: Press, Mixer and Basin
description: Create machines do not work through menus.

pages.title: Press, Mixer and Basin
pages.text:
Create machines do not work through menus. They act on **items sitting in front of them**: items on a belt, on a depot, or inside a basin. Most of them need [#](2E5AAC)[rotation](entry://create_basics/rotation)[#]() to run.\
\
Hover a machine and hold W for its Ponder.

pages.title: Mechanical Press
pages.text: Hits whatever is under it. On a belt or depot it presses ingots into sheets. Over a basin it compacts the contents.

Pressing a plain item makes a **sheet**: iron, gold, copper and brass sheets are building blocks for later machines.\
\
Over a **Basin**, the press compacts: any filled 2x2 or 3x3 crafting recipe, plus some extras (some need heat, see [#](2E5AAC)[Heat](entry://create_basics/heat)[#]()).

pages.title: Mechanical Mixer
pages.text: Sits above a basin and stirs. Handles any shapeless crafting recipe, plus extra recipes like alloying.

pages.title: Basin
pages.text: Holds items and fluids for the mixer or press above it. Has no output until you give it one.

Brass is the classic mixer job: copper and zinc ingots in a basin, with a [#](2E5AAC)[heated](entry://create_basics/heat)[#]() burner under it. Check JEI for the exact mix.\
\
If two recipes fit the same contents, put an item in the machine's filter slot to pick one.

**Basin output**: put a belt, funnel, depot or chute below and to the side, and the basin shows a faucet and pushes finished items out. With no output block it keeps results inside, useful when they are ingredients for the next step.\
\
If you pull from a basin, use a [#](2E5AAC)[filter](entry://create_basics/item_logistics)[#]() so unprocessed items stay.
